summary: Student Choice (JEE Main): I tested the backend and the frontend, only on disposable tejas_isolated_* DBs, running one suite at a time through tests/runners/solo.sh. choice_iso229 passed 89/89. I wrote a new adversarial and contract suite, tests/choice_adversarial_t1_232.py, which passed 80/80. It covers: strict types; request_key length 8..100; page 0 and page 7 on a 320-question chapter that is capped at 6 pages; picture links with an expired exp, a wrong index, an exp too far ahead and another set id, all with VALID signatures, all 404; another student's paper giving 404 on my/sets, preflight, start and results; max_per_subject (pick 422, random 15 = 5+5+5); max_questions 10; daily_limit 2 (third paper 429 with the exact sentence); stale and future expected_revision 409; reviewer 403 on GET and PUT; door A has exactly 5 keys; door B item keys and stem w/h both-or-neither; minutes 10+10+10=72, 25 Maths=80, 75 Maths=240; 6 racing requests with the same key make 1 paper and use 1 slot; a 48 KB body gives 413; my/sets and start work without an Origin header; my/tests carries test_kind; the cohort reason. Regression was as expected: chapters_iso182 58/58, analysis_iso195 62/62, test_integrity176 32/32, db_audit_iso194 71/71, master_iso181 124/124, library_aits_iso180 125/125, pictures_iso220 66/66, get_ready_iso188 35/36 (the known 'book-mock set built :: held' failure). UI: the main walk ui229 passed 35/35 (desktop and mobile). My new extra walk, tests/ui_choice_t1_232.py, passed 24/24. It covers: the paper page eyebrow 'JEE MAIN · STUDENT CHOICE', no Save button, and back to /choice; results ?view=rank shows result-choice-no-rank; the history badge 'Student Choice'; random-only mode (step=tests goes Start -> Resume, and step=questions falls back to tests); a normal chapter SetDetail is unchanged; no sideways overflow at 390 px. I only READ the real preview DB: tejas_choice_settings is empty (both switches Off) and there are 0 papers. No writes there and no sign-ups on the preview URL. Found: one real UI styling bug (the rank notice has no styles) and one minor backend cache window.

minor.issue: choice.pool() is cached for 30 s per process, and nothing clears it when the owner sets a chapter test to live_enabled=False or archives it. Reproduced: I listed TEST_M2, set it live_enabled False, then picked inside the cache window. The paper was made (200) and its first Start also gave 200, freezing the un-live chapter's questions into the paper. Once the cache expired, pick gave 422 GONE as designed. Unpublishing IS caught, because build_questions checks status 'published'. The window is at most 30 s.

With max_per_subject=5 and count=20, the 422 says 'Abhi Physics ke sirf 5 sawaal hain. Kam ginti likho.' (the FEW sentence), but Physics has hundreds of questions. The limit comes from the owner's cap, not a shortage of questions. The message misleads.
A signed-out call with an invalid body returns 422, because body validation runs before auth. With a valid body it returns 401. Harmless; noted for the app's error mapping.
The daily slot is reserved before papers.insert_one. If the insert fails for a reason other than a duplicate, that slot is lost. A retry with the same key still works. Low risk.

ui_bugs.issue: The .result-choice-no-rank rules are in src/choice.css, which only StudentChoice.js and AdminChoice.js import. Opening /results/<id>?view=rank directly, or from My Tests or history (the normal path), shows the notice with no styles: no card, a small cramped heading, and the icon on its own line above the heading. Screenshot: /app/.screenshots/ui232/desk_results_rank.jpeg. The Home rule .choice-card .mf-title has the same cause: it only applies after /choice has been visited.

issues: Ticked chapters are saved in localStorage, so each browser keeps its own. On a new device step=tests shows 'Pehle chapters tick karo' (choice-tests-none). This works as built; noted for information.

action_items: Style the Student Choice rank notice on the Results page: either add import '../choice.css' to Results.js, or move the 3 .result-choice-no-rank rules into a stylesheet that Results already loads.

Optional: clear choice._pool (for example with choice.reset()) when a JEE Main chapter test is made un-live, archived or edited. This stops a paper being made and started from it during the 30 s window.
Optional: give the 422 its own sentence when a random count is more than max_per_subject x subjects, and/or limit the random range shown to 3..min(max_questions, cap x subjects).
critical_code_review_comments: choice.py is 663 lines, close to the 700-line split limit.

The settings cache (15 s) and pool cache (30 s) are per process. With several workers, switching a way off can take up to 15 s to reach the other workers. The owner page says 'The website follows at once'.
The strict pydantic Payload correctly refuses a float, bool or string count and extra keys. The request_key pattern is checked in the handler and gives 422 BAD_KEY.
The picture route signs (set, token, index, exp) and only accepts exp between now and 3 days ahead. Tampered, expired, wrong-index and other-set links all gave 404.

success_rate.backend: 100% (89/89 + 80/80; regressions as expected, 1 known older failure)

test_credentials: None. All accounts were throw-away ones inside tejas_isolated_* DBs; nothing was created on the preview URL.

rca of the issue: Unstyled rank notice: Results.js uses the class result-choice-no-rank, but its rules are in src/choice.css. That file is loaded only by the lazy StudentChoice and AdminChoice chunks, so a direct visit to /results never has them.
